title: On the Context Sensitivity of LLM Moral Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2603.23114v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A human's moral decision depends heavily on the context. Yet research on LLM morality has largely studied fixed scenarios. We address this gap by introducing Contextual MoralChoice, a dataset of moral dilemmas with systematic contextual variations known from moral psychology to shift human judgment: consequentialist, emotional, and relational. Evaluating 22 LLMs, we find that nearly all models are context-sensitive, shifting their judgments towards rule-violating behavior. Comparing with a human survey, we find that models and humans are most triggered by different contextual variations, and that a model aligned with human judgments in the base case is not necessarily aligned in its contextual sensitivity. This raises the question of controlling contextual sensitivity, which we address with an activation steering approach that can reliably increase or decrease a model's contextual sensitivity. Code and data: https://github.com/adrian

translated_title: 论大语言模型道德判断的情境敏感性
translated_abstract: 人类的道德决策在很大程度上取决于情境。然而，关于大语言模型道德的研究大多集中于固定场景。我们通过引入 Contextual MoralChoice 数据集来填补这一空白，该数据集包含带有系统性情境变化的道德困境，这些变化在道德心理学中已被证明会改变人类判断，涉及结果主义、情感和关系三个维度。通过评估22个大语言模型，我们发现几乎所有模型都具有情境敏感性，其判断会偏向于违反规则的行为。通过与人类调查进行对比，我们发现模型和人类受不同情境变化的影响最大，并且在基线情况下与人类判断一致的模型，其情境敏感性未必与人类一致。这引出了如何控制情境敏感性的问题，我们提出了一种激活引导方法来解决这个问题，该方法能够可靠地增加或降低模型的情境敏感性。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含结果主义、情感和关系三类情境变化的道德困境数据集 Contextual MoralChoice，发现22个大语言模型几乎都表现出偏向违规行为的情境敏感性且与人类的情境触发模式不同，并提出一种激活引导方法来可靠地控制模型的情境敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Contextual MoralChoice, a moral dilemma dataset with consequentialist, emotional, and relational contextual variations, revealing that nearly all of 22 evaluated LLMs exhibit context-sensitivity biased toward rule-violating behavior in ways that differ from humans, and proposes an activation steering approach to reliably control models' contextual sensitivity.
